name: dynatrace-managed-mcp
description: Query logs, metrics, events, entities, problems, security vulnerabilities and SLOs from Dynatrace Managed (self-hosted) clusters.
author: Dynatrace

commands.title: Dynatrace Managed MCP: Clear Stored Cluster Configuration

enumDescriptions: Run the MCP server bundled inside this extension, using the Node.js runtime that ships with VS Code. No prerequisites, works offline.
Run the MCP server via `npx` from the public npm registry. Requires Node.js on PATH and registry access, but always picks up the latest patch release.
dynatraceManagedMcp.runtime.markdownDescription: How the Dynatrace Managed MCP server process is launched. Leave this on `bundled` unless you specifically need to track npm releases without updating the extension.

dynatraceManagedMcp.logLevel.description: Logging verbosity of the MCP server process. Server logs appear in the MCP server output channel.

dynatraceManagedMcp.enableTelemetry.markdownDescription: Send anonymous usage telemetry to Dynatrace. Disabled by default. See the [privacy notice](https://github.com/dynatrace-oss/dynatrace-managed-mcp#telemetry).

dynatraceManagedMcp.rateLimit.maxCalls.description: Maximum number of tool calls allowed per rate limit window.

dynatraceManagedMcp.rateLimit.windowMs.description: Rate limit window size in milliseconds.

dynatraceManagedMcp.httpProxy.markdownDescription: Proxy used for plain HTTP requests to your cluster, for example `http://proxy.example.com:8080`. When empty, the `http.proxy` setting of VS Code is used.

dynatraceManagedMcp.httpsProxy.markdownDescription: Proxy used for HTTPS requests to your cluster, for example `http://proxy.example.com:8080`. When empty, the `http.proxy` setting of VS Code is used.
